text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First place!! I actually got first place! 
Isn't that amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was completely mediocre, but 
maybe I'm surprisingly talented...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a wonderful run!
Yeah, that was a great run!

Let's work on developing that talent even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, that's way too much praise! 
You're gonna make me get way ahead of 
myself, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, honestly, I'm really happy. I'll 
do my best to take first place next time 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Were you being serious...? No, yeah, 
coming from you, Trainer, I guess that 
makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I have talent or not, 
but... yeah. I want to keep getting 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――The sense of achievement crossing the 
line in 1st place was off the charts! I 
want to experience it again!
